description: BEMP常用查询模板 - Oracle/MySQL双数据库查询模板集合

common.description: Oracle/MySQL通用查询模板（语法完全相同）

templates.name: queryAuthority
templates.sql: SELECT ID, AUTH_NAME, AUTH_TYPE, PARENT_ID, URL FROM TM_AUTHORITY WHERE ID IN ({ID_LIST}) ORDER BY ID;

templates.name: queryBusinessParam
templates.sql: SELECT PARAM_KEY, PARAM_NAME, PARAM_VALUE FROM TM_BUSINESS_PARAMETER WHERE PARAM_KEY LIKE '{PREFIX}%';

templates.name: describeColumns
templates.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, DATA_LENGTH, NULLABLE FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER('{TABLE_NAME}') ORDER BY COLUMN_ID;

templates.name: timeRangeNumberType
templates.description: 时间范围查询(NUMBER类型时间字段)
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM {TABLE_NAME} WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR({TIME_FIELD}), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF') >= SYSDATE - {DAYS} ORDER BY {TIME_FIELD} DESC;

templates.name: timeRangeDateType
templates.description: 时间范围查询(DATE/TIMESTAMP类型时间字段)
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM {TABLE_NAME} WHERE {TIME_FIELD} >= SYSDATE - {DAYS} ORDER BY {TIME_FIELD} DESC;

templates.name: describeColumns
templates.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_DEFAULT FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{DATABASE}' AND TABLE_NAME = '{TABLE_NAME}' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION;

templates.name: timeRange
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM {TABLE_NAME} WHERE {TIME_FIELD} >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL {DAYS} DAY) ORDER BY {TIME_FIELD} DESC;

notes: {TABLE_NAME}、{CONDITION}、{ID_LIST}、{PREFIX}、{DATABASE}、{TIME_FIELD}、{DAYS}为占位符，使用时替换为实际值
BEMP系统中时间字段可能存储为NUMBER类型(格式YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF)，Oracle需根据字段类型选择对应模板
可通过 USER_TAB_COLUMNS(Oracle) 或 INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS(MySQL) 查看字段数据类型
